description: This file contains implementations for classes related to text and path parsing within the Thunder project, including methods for reading text, parsing paths, extracting filename components, and handling delimiters.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing text within a buffer, including reading text until delimiters and skipping characters.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class designed to parse filesystem paths into drive, filename, extension, and path components.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads text up to specified delimiters, considering whether the text is quoted, and returns the position.

methods.name: ReadText (overloaded)
methods.description: Reads a segment of text into a result object based on delimiters and current parsing position.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a given text fragment into drive, path, filename, base filename, and extension components.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
